_comment: The Drip slot machine (DESIGN.md §6.7, SkinTable, Cosmetics), checked by SkinTable.problems() when the items load. price: Drip for one spin; ten_price: for ten at once. odds: the chance of each rarity a spin rolls (adding up to 1). pity: the spin number `spins` in a row without `rarity` or better rolls that rarity or better (by the odds of those rarities); any spin of it or better starts the count again. season_weight: how many times as likely a skin of the season in the machine is than a core skin of the same rarity. duplicate_drip: the Drip a skin you already own pays back, by rarity. bound_rarities: skins of these rarities are bound (outfits always are): lost with an item, they go back to the collection. wear: the five wear bands from best to worst, each up to `max` (the last ends at 1), with the chance a drop lands in it (adding up to 1); a drop's wear is spread evenly inside its band. seasons: the seasonal collections in the machine, one at a time, each for `days` days from `start` (a Monday, UTC), in `order`, then round again. near_miss: the reels tease a high result on this share of the results below `below` (looks only). item_slots: the cosmetic slots each kind of item has (skin: a skin of the item's kind; sticker; charm).
